drugs.name: Nitroglycerine
drugs.detail: Hold if SBP <100, recent ED meds (Viagra/Cialis 24h), inferior MI / RV infarct.

drugs.name: Nitroglycerine (CHF)
drugs.deliveryDose: 3 sprays SL together · then 1 spray q3–5 min
drugs.detail: High-dose nitro for CHF. Maintain SBP > 100.

drugs.name: Albuterol
drugs.deliveryDose: Neb 3 mL via mask · May repeat ×3
drugs.detail: Continuous neb for severe. Peds: 2.5 mg same dose (or 1.25 mg <1 yr).

drugs.name: Diphenhydramine
drugs.detail: 1–2 mg/kg IV/IO/IM. Max 50 mg.

drugs.name: Epinephrine 1:1,000
drugs.deliveryDose: 0.5 mL IM lateral thigh · May repeat q5 min × 2
drugs.detail: ANAPHYLAXIS / AIRWAY first-line. 0.5 mg IM. NOT for cardiac arrest — use 1:10,000 IV/IO instead.

drugs.name: Epi Pen (Adult)
drugs.detail: Adult / child ≥30 kg. May repeat q5 min × 2.

drugs.name: Solu-Medrol
drugs.detail: 1–2 mg/kg IV/IO/IM. Max 125 mg.

drugs.name: Dexamethasone
drugs.detail: 0.6 mg/kg. Max 10 mg.

drugs.name: Ondansetron
drugs.deliveryDose: 2 mL slow IV/IO/IM · ODT 4 mg PO
drugs.detail: 4 mg IV/IO over 2 min. Peds: 0.1–0.15 mg/kg max 4 mg.

drugs.name: Adenosine (Adenocard)
drugs.deliveryDose: Push 4 mL RAPID + 20 mL NS flush · proximal port
drugs.detail: 1st: 12 mg IVP rapid. 2nd: 12 mg IVP rapid. Always immediately follow with 20 mL NS flush.

drugs.name: Diltiazem
drugs.indication: Stable AFib / AFlutter RVR · NOT in WPW
drugs.deliveryDose: 20.0 mL slow IV push over 2 min
drugs.detail: 0.25 mg/kg slow IV push over 2 min. Max 20 mg single dose. NOT in WPW, hypotension, or wide-complex tachycardia.

drugs.name: Atropine (bradycardia)
drugs.detail: 1 mg IV/IO q3–5 min. Max 3 mg cumulative. Peds: 0.02 mg/kg (min 0.1 mg, max 0.5 mg).

drugs.name: Lidocaine 2% (IO Anesthesia)
drugs.deliveryDose: 2 mL slow IO · Wait 60 sec · Then NS flush
drugs.detail: 40 mg IO before flush. Numbs the marrow in conscious patients. Wait 60 sec, then standard NS flush.

drugs.name: Naloxone (Narcan)
drugs.packageSpec: 1 mg/mL · 2 mL vial (2 mg) · 4 mg IN spray
drugs.deliveryDose: 0.4–2 mL IV/IM · IN: 1 spray per nostril
drugs.detail: Start 0.4–2 mg, titrate to respirations. May repeat q2–3 min. PEARL: NOT for cardiac arrest. IN: 4 mg/spray q3 min.

drugs.name: Tranexamic Acid (TXA)
drugs.deliveryDose: Push 20 mL slow IVP over 2 min
drugs.detail: 2 g IV/IO slow push over 2 min. Within 3 hours of injury. Peds: 15 mg/kg max 1 g.

drugs.name: Oral Glucose
drugs.detail: Adult 30 g PO (Peds 15 g). Only if patient can protect airway and swallow.

drugs.name: D10W
drugs.deliveryDose: Infuse 250 mL bag IV/IO · titrate to BGL > 80
drugs.detail: Adult: 25 g (250 mL bag) IV/IO. Peds: 0.5–1 g/kg (5–10 mL/kg of D10). NEVER D50 in peds.

drugs.name: Midazolam (Versed)
drugs.deliveryDose: Seizure 5 mg IV/IO or 10 mg IM/IN · Anxiety 2 mg
drugs.detail: Seizure/dissociation: 5 mg IV/IO or 10 mg IM/IN, repeat q5 min. Severe anxiety: 2 mg. Sympathomimetic tox: 5 mg IV or 10 mg IM/IN q5 min.

drugs.name: Fentanyl (Sublimaze)
drugs.detail: 1 mcg/kg IV/IO/IM/IN, repeat q10 min PRN. Preferred analgesic for chest pain.

drugs.name: Ketamine (Ketalar)
drugs.detail: Sub-dissociative pain 0.2 mg/kg; procedural sedation 1 mg/kg IV/IO or 2 mg/kg IM/IN; hyperactive delirium 4 mg/kg IM (max 500 mg).

drugs.name: Morphine
drugs.detail: 0.2 mg/kg IV/IO/IM/IN q20 min PRN.

drugs.name: Hydromorphone (Dilaudid)
drugs.detail: 1 mg IV/IO/IM/IN q20 min PRN.

drugs.name: Ketorolac (Toradol)
drugs.detail: 15 mg IV/IO/IM. CONTRAINDICATED > 75 y/o, active GI bleed, or renal failure.

drugs.name: Acetaminophen (Tylenol)
drugs.detail: 1 g IV/IO over 15 min. Contraindicated in liver failure. Peds 15 mg/kg (max 500 mg).

drugs.name: Lorazepam (Ativan)
drugs.detail: 2 mg IV/IO/IM; may repeat ×1 after 10–15 min (max total 8 mg).

drugs.name: Diazepam (Valium)
drugs.detail: 5 mg IV/IO; repeat q5 min PRN.

drugs.name: Droperidol
drugs.detail: Nausea/vomiting 1.25 mg; hyperactive delirium 5 mg IM/IV/IO. Caution: known long QT.

drugs.name: Promethazine (Phenergan)
drugs.detail: 25 mg IV. Extravasation can cause severe tissue damage.

drugs.name: Labetalol
drugs.detail: 20 mg IV → 40 mg → 80 mg q10 min (max cumulative 300 mg). Target SBP 130–150 / DBP 80–100. Exclusions: trauma, HR<60, CHF, heart block, asthma.

drugs.name: Levetiracetam (Keppra)
drugs.detail: 2 g IV/IO infusion. Second-line for prolonged or refractory seizures.

drugs.name: Hydroxocobalamin (Cyanokit)
drugs.detail: 5 g IV/IO over 15 min. Enclosed-fire victim + AMS / hypotension / low EtCO₂ / arrest. Peds 70 mg/kg (max 1 kit).

drugs.name: Whole Blood
drugs.detail: 1 unit IV/IO, repeat as needed. Dedicated line; monitor for transfusion reaction. Peds ≥5 y: 10 mL/kg (max 1 unit). Contra: isolated penetrating head injury GCS 3.

drugs.name: Norepinephrine (Levophed)
drugs.detail: Infusion 0.1–0.5 mcg/kg/min, titrate to MAP > 65.

defib.detail: Pad placement: Anterior/Posterior. GNFR escalating: 120 J (1st) → 150 J (2nd) → 200 J (3rd+). Monophasic: 360 J. After 3rd shock + anti-dysrhythmic → consider DSD for refractory VF.

cardiovert.detail: Synchronized cardioversion — escalating energy ladder: 70 J (1st) → 120 J (2nd) → 150 J (3rd+). Sedate if conscious and time permits. Polymorphic VT: treat as VF with unsynchronized defib doses.

pace.detail: Start 80 BPM. Increase mA by 10 until electrical + mechanical capture. Typical 50–100 mA.

airway.ioDetail: EZ-IO. Adult proximal humerus = fastest flow.

drips.name: Crystalloid Bolus
drips.detail: Rapid IV/IO push. Repeat as needed. Watch for fluid overload in CHF or elderly.

drips.name: Push-Dose Epi
drips.rate: 10 mL IVP (~100 mcg) titrate to BP
drips.detail: Mix: 1 mL Epi 1:1,000 + 100 mL D5W bag = 10 mcg/mL. Draw 10 mL off bag · Push 10 mL IVP · titrate q2 min PRN.

drips.name: Epi Pressor Drip
drips.detail: Mix: 1 mg of 1:1,000 in 100 mL D5W = 10 mcg/mL · 10 gtts/set (macrodrip). Range 0.1–0.5 mcg/kg/min. At 100 kg: low 10 gtts/min → high 50 gtts/min. Titrate to MAP > 65.

drips.name: Epi Bradycardia Drip
drips.detail: Mix: 1 mg of 1:1,000 in 100 mL D5W = 10 mcg/mL · 60 gtts/set (microdrip). Range 2–10 mcg/min · gtts/min = mcg/min × 6. NOT weight-based. Titrate to HR > 60 and perfusion.

drips.name: Amiodarone Maintenance
drips.detail: 150 mg (3 mL) + 100 mL D5W = 1.5 mg/mL · 10 gtts/set. Run at 100 gtts/min for the first 10 min, then continue 1 mg/min for 6 hr, then 0.5 mg/min for 18 hr.

drips.name: Mag Sulfate — Torsades
drips.detail: Mix: 4 mL of 50% (2 g) + 100 mL D5W = 20 mg/mL · 10 gtts/set. Wide open over 1–2 min in TdP arrest. 5–15 min in pulsed TdP.

drips.name: Mag Sulfate — Asthma
drips.detail: Mix: 4 mL of 50% (2 g) + 100 mL D5W = 20 mg/mL · 10 gtts/set. Slow infusion 50 gtts/min over 20 min.

drips.name: Mag Sulfate — Eclampsia
drips.detail: Mix: 8 mL of 50% (4 g) + 100 mL D5W = 40 mg/mL · 10 gtts/set. 4 g over 20 min initial loading dose. Maintenance 1–2 g/hr.

drips.name: Diltiazem
drips.detail: 0.25 mg/kg slow IVP over 2 min, max 20 mg. At 100 kg: 20.0 mg = 20.0 mL of 1 mg/mL. If inadequate after 15 min, repeat 0.35 mg/kg.
